scope: Native saved-run verification of retained fictional records; no mocked CRM responses. Browser error/create checks use simulated responses separately.

initialAttempt.outcome: Verification refused an existing preview/receipt plan-ID mismatch after the title update. The saved rollback restored the title; direct reads confirmed all nine retained records matched starting compared fields before rerunning.
initialAttempt.fix: Execution retains the reviewed preview ID after current-state validation. Both-provider regression tests reproduce the old mismatch and pass with the correction.

limits: HubSpot STANDARD and Salesforce Developer Edition are designated development accounts, not formally provisioned sandboxes.
Native product verification compared primary email and six portable fields for one updated person per provider; no create-result qualification in this run.
The independent fixture read compared portable fields, primary email, state, city, markers and owners for nine records per provider; audit timestamps and other fields were not compared.
The difference after rollback was intentional. No claim that a CRM automation caused it.
Rechecks use the current connection and save only the latest observation. There is no continuous monitoring, automatic repair, or account identity binding for historical runs.
Provider read failures, missing records, converted Leads and created-record verification were exercised with simulated responses.
